# BOHOL - 35,000 m² Smart Factory & Adult Personal Wellness OEM/ODM Manufacturer
> BOHOL is a direct vertically-integrated manufacturing headquarters based in Guangdong (Meizhou & Shenzhen R&D), specializing in adult intimate wellness hardware, Class 100,000 cleanroom medical liquid silicone (LSR) injection, 5-axis CNC steel mold tooling, proprietary private-mold hardware, commercial hotel vending micro-terminals, and turnkey consumable refills.

## Core Capabilities & Key Numbers
- Integrated Manufacturing Campus: 35,000 square meters (Guangdong, China)
- Lean Assembly Lines: 120+ active lines (ISO Class 100,000 cleanrooms)
- Monthly Production Output: 500,000+ units (<0.2% field defect rate; AQL 0.65/1.0)
- International Export: 60+ countries with all-inclusive Air DDP (7–10 days) & Sea DDP (18–28 days)
- Low-MOQ Flexibility: 1-unit evaluation samples (24–48h dispatch), 50-unit wholesale, 100–300 unit Private Label (custom logo & box), 500-unit custom Pantone LSR & white-label BLE 5.3 App
- Tooling & IP Protection: In-house 5-axis DMG MORI CNC steel molds (±0.01 mm tolerance, 20–25 days) under China-enforceable bilingual NNN & mold ownership contracts
- Material & Safety Certifications: ISO 13485:2016, ISO 9001:2015, US FDA Registration (FEI: 3014686907), FDA 21 CFR § 177.2600, ISO 10993 biocompatibility, EU RoHS 2.0, REACH SVHC, CE-RED, FCC Part 15C, UL 1642 / IEC 62133, and UN38.3
- Testing Protocols: 100% automated IPX7/IPX8 vacuum decay leak testing (-50 kPa), <35–42 dB anechoic soundroom testing, Shore 00–55A ASTM D2240 durometer checks, and 72-hour battery burn-in aging
